episodes.synopsis: Master Kongo finally decides to give the young Phos an assignment. Much to Phos dismay the assignment is to write an encyclopedia about the world.
episodes.title: Phosphophyllite

episodes.synopsis: Phos is looking for ideas for the encyclopedia but is struggling to come up with anything. They go to Diamond for help as they have been working on a new technique.
episodes.title: Diamond

episodes.synopsis: Unable to find Phos the group is concerned of what happened to them. However, Diamond is determined to bring Phos back.
episodes.title: Metamorphose

episodes.synopsis: Phos is attacked, but manages to make a new friend out of the attacker. Together, both travel to the ocean where Phos learns more about the past.
episodes.title: Soul - Flesh - Bone

episodes.synopsis: Phos is captured by the Lunarians. King reveals the truth behind the deception but is interrupted by their slumbering brother.
episodes.title: Return

episodes.synopsis: Phos has recovered from the disaster at sea and has gained a new ability! What will happen to Phos as they put their skill to use as a lookout?
episodes.title: First Battle

episodes.synopsis: It's winter time and everyone is discussing the best way to make it through the cold. Meanwhile, Phos gets roped into Antarcticite's yearly duties.
episodes.title: Hibernation

episodes.synopsis: Pho has lost their arms, but Master Kongo believes them to be at the Chord Shore. Antarcticite makes it their mission to piece Phos back together.
episodes.title: Antarcticite

episodes.synopsis: Spring comes with a bitter taste for Phos as they try to cope with the kidnapping of Antarcticite. In the meantime, the gems are trying to come to terms with the new Phos.
episodes.title: Spring

episodes.synopsis: To help them get a better grasp of their new-found abilities, Bort and Phos team up. Dia on the other hand feels a bit left out.
episodes.title: Shiro

episodes.synopsis: A recent incident has ignited some internal questions in Phos' mind. Who's Shiro and why is Sensei so kind to this Lunarian?
episodes.title: Secrets

episodes.synopsis: Phos must now decide to follow their instinct or back down. What will happen if they try to investigate further?
episodes.title: New Work
